# montecarlo_informatica_v2_credentials (Data Source)





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `credentials_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `auth_mode` (String) How Monte Carlo signs in. `password` takes `username` and `password`. `oauth` takes `org_id` and the `oauth_*` fields.
- `base_url` (String) Informatica login URL for your POD. Leave it out for https://dm-us.informaticacloud.com. Null unless set.
- `connection_type` (String) The connection type the credentials are for, such as `snowflake`. Fixed once created.
- `created_time` (String) When the credentials were created.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the credentials.
- `oauth_access_token_endpoint` (String) Identity provider URL Monte Carlo requests tokens from. Null unless `auth_mode` is oauth.
- `oauth_client_id` (String) Client ID of the identity provider app. Null unless `auth_mode` is oauth.
- `oauth_grant_type` (String) Grant Monte Carlo requests the token with. Null unless `auth_mode` is oauth.
- `oauth_scope` (String) Scope the token is requested with. Null unless set.
- `oauth_username` (String) Identity provider user. Null unless the grant is password.
- `org_id` (String) Informatica organization ID. Null unless `auth_mode` is oauth.
- `storage_type` (String) Where the secret lives. Fixed once created.
- `username` (String) Informatica user. Null unless `auth_mode` is password.
